{{- /* Search is the exact stack the live docs run: jQuery + gooddata.ai's search-common.js + quicksearch-plugin-v2.js, initialised with $("#adds-container").gdQuickSearch({tab, version}). The plugin then pulls in addsearch-js-client / addsearch-search-ui and gooddata.ai's search-dialog.js + search-dialog.css, which render the input and the autocomplete into #adds-container. There is no build-time index: results come from the hosted AddSearch index and deep-link to the production pages, so search works identically on dev servers, PR previews and prod. The previous `https://addsearch.com/js/?key=` line was AddSearch's generic hosted widget — a different UI from the one readers know. `addSearchTab` is the Docsy-era param name the site already sets ("gd-ui-doc"); `search.customFieldVersion` narrows results to one docs version (live sets it to the current release; empty = latest). */ -}} {{- $s := site.Params.search -}} {{- if and $s (eq $s.provider "addsearch") -}} {{- $opts := dict "tab" (site.Params.addSearchTab | default "gd-ui-doc") -}} {{- with $s.customFieldVersion }}{{ $opts = merge $opts (dict "version" .) }}{{ end -}} {{- /* Positioned only at lg, so the results panel hangs off the box on desktop but, on phones, off the header's own relative wrapper — the box there is ~100px wide and the panel needs the full viewport. */ -}}
{{- end -}}
